description: Give nanobot ears and a voice.

setup.tryIt: Let nanobot speak a test message.
setup.summary: Voice channel with wake word detection for local microphone/speaker interaction.
steps: Obtain access key from Picovoice Console (https://console.picovoice.ai/).
Select a microphone device index and adjust wake word settings.

picovoice_access_key.label: Picovoice access key
picovoice_access_key.help: Obtain access key from Picovoice Console, see https://console.picovoice.ai/.

porcupine_model.label: Porcupine model (.pv)
porcupine_model.help: Path to the Porcupine speech model file (.pv), e.g. a language-specific model like porcupine_params_de.pv. This is NOT the wake word itself — custom wake words go into 'Custom wake word paths' (.ppn). Leave empty for the default English model.

wake_word_keywords.label: Wake words
wake_word_keywords.help: Built-in wake word names (e.g. 'nano'). Only used when no custom wake word paths (.ppn) are set.

wake_word_keyword_paths.label: Custom wake word paths (.ppn)
wake_word_keyword_paths.help: Paths to compiled custom wake word keyword files (.ppn) built in the Picovoice Console. These take precedence over the built-in 'Wake words' and require a matching .pv model (see 'Porcupine model').

wake_word_sensitivities.label: Wake word sensitivities
wake_word_sensitivities.help: Wake word sensitivities from 0.0 to 1.0 (higher = detects at greater distance/noise), one per wake word in the same order. Missing values default to 0.5.

audio_device_index.label: Audio device index
audio_device_index.help: Index of the microphone device used for recording.

silence_threshold.label: Silence threshold
silence_threshold.help: Audio amplitude below which input is considered silence.

silence_duration.label: Silence duration
silence_duration.help: Silence duration in milliseconds before recording stops.

led_command.label: LED status command
led_command.help: Optional shell command to drive a status LED; receives the status as $1.

tts_voice.label: Voice
tts_voice.help: The voice nanobot uses to answer, see https://edge-tts.com/.

allowFrom.label: Allowed users
allowFrom.help: Sender IDs that may talk to nanobot. Use 'local_speaker' to allow the person speaking into the local microphone, '*' for everyone.
